Second correction of kk and en texts of the two demo tenants of REQ-070 (WF-02 step 8, criterion 5; decisions/0087). The readers' second pass is in answers2-kk.txt and answers2-en.txt in the folder rd70 of the session scratchpad folder named in the launching message (pairs in pairs2-kk.txt, pairs2-en.txt; the map number -> tenant and path in index.json there; never copy them into the project). Pass 2 result: kk 14 yes and 1 no; en 20 yes and 5 no. This is the LAST correction allowed: a third «нет» for a pair goes to the owner, so choose the wording with care.
Correct exactly: kk pair 108 (en pairs are separate); en pairs 40, 83, 98, 153, 161. For each, read the reader's reason in the answers file, the ru text, the neighbouring texts of the same file (so one term per concept stays), and decide the final wording yourself (the suggestions are only suggestions; for 83 the English sentence must say the terminal is the basis of a warehouse with terminals in natural English; for 98 the tense and the structure of the Russian «Соберём … — пока вы отвечаете» must be kept; for 153 and 161 add nothing that the Russian text does not say, no «your» unless the ru says «ваш»; in 161 «на связи» is «available/one contact person», not «on call»). Check that the new wording does not equal any text of the other tenant file (fold case and spaces), that the numbers equal in ru, kk, en, no Cyrillic in en. Change only those six strings in tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json and agency.json, then `npx prettier --write` on both, `cd tools && npm run picker -- check` on both (code 0, same line), then `npm run check` once (only DT-2c is expected red; report the red tests; change no test). In result.changes give pair, tenant, path, language, was, became. Write set: the two tenant files and your handoff. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands.
